name: Schleifenbauer Databus Generic (MIB)
description: Auto-compiled with libsmi from 2 MIB module(s). 204 readable OIDs under 1.3.6.1.4.1.31034.

oids.name: spdmVersion
oids.description: Data model version, currently 1.10

oids.name: firmwareVersion
oids.description: The units firmware revision number.

oids.name: buildNumber
oids.description: Date and time of latest build of the firmware.

oids.name: salesOrderNumber
oids.description: SP sales order number.

oids.name: productId
oids.description: SP product id.

oids.name: serialNumber
oids.description: SP serial number.

oids.name: hardwareAddress
oids.description: Hardware serial number; cannot be changed. Can be used as backup unit address. format as 3 unsigned ints separated by dashes: int - int - int

oids.name: macAddress
oids.description: The ethernet interfaces unique hardware address.

oids.name: unitAddress
oids.description: User defined address; this will be used for addressing the unit.

oids.name: deviceName
oids.description: User configurable device name or identifier.

oids.name: deviceLocation
oids.description: User configurable device location identifier.

oids.name: vanityTag
oids.description: Characters to be displayed as vanity tekst in display.

oids.name: noPhases
oids.description: Either zero, one or three for no input metering, single or three phase system

oids.name: noOutletsTotal
oids.description: Total number of outlets, even hardwired without switch/measure modules.

oids.name: noSwitchedOutlets
oids.description: Number of switched outlets. If outlet numbering is non-contiguous: the highest outlet number.

oids.name: noMeasuredOutlets
oids.description: Number of measured outlets. If outlet numbering is non-contiguous: the highest outlet number.

oids.name: noSensors
oids.description: The number of external, digital environmental sensors: 0 for none, 1 to 16 depending on number of reported sensors

oids.name: maximumLoad
oids.description: Maximum rated load of device per phase, usually either 16 or 32 A.

oids.name: deviceStatusCode
oids.description: Returns an internal status or error code. 0 = OK, 16 = watchdog timer caused reset, 128 = slave module was reset, 144 = both previous.

oids.name: temperatureAlert
oids.description: An alert has been raised due to temperature exceeding treshhold; 0= no alert; 1= internal unit temp, 2= external sensor.

oids.name: inputCurrentAlert
oids.description: An alert has been raised due to current exceeding treshhold; 0=no alert; 1-3 for input phase.

oids.name: outputCurrentAlert
oids.description: An alert has been raised due to current exceeding treshhold; 0=no alert; 1-48 for outlet.

oids.name: inputVoltageAlert
oids.description: An alert has been raised due to a voltage dip; 0=no alert; 1-3 for input phase.

oids.name: oCurrentDropAlert
oids.description: An alert has been raised due to the current of a measured outlet suddenly dropping to near zero, possibly indicating a blown fuse; 0=no alert; 1-48 for outlet.

oids.name: iCurrentDropAlert
oids.description: An alert has been raised due to the current of a measured input suddenly dropping to near zero, possibly indicating a blown fuse; 0=no alert; 1-3 for phase.

oids.name: rebootDevice
oids.description: Warm reboot/reset of device; note: this will have no effect on outlet status!

oids.name: resetAlerts
oids.description: Reset all alert signals.

oids.name: zeroInputKWhSubtotal
oids.description: Reset of input kWh subtotal counters to zero.

oids.name: zeroOutKWhSubtotal
oids.description: Reset of outlet kWh subtotal counter to zero.

oids.name: resetPeakValues
oids.description: Reset all peak values to zero, as well input as output metering, voltages dips, current peaks and temperatures.

oids.name: peakDuration
oids.description: A current peak should last at least [stpkdr] MilliSeconds before an alert is raised; max about a minute.

oids.name: fixedOutletDelay
oids.description: Minimal delay between two successive relay switches in milliseconds. Minimal delay is 100 ms. Will always be respected!

oids.name: powerSaverMode
oids.description: Set backlight on time in seconds; 0 keeps display always on. Note that keeping the backlight on may decrease luminosity over time. Setting this to other values than 10, 60, 120 or 240 is incompatib...

oids.name: outletPowerupMode
oids.description: Behaviour of outlet on power-up: 0=off; 1=same state as at power down; 2=same state, but delayed by individual delay timer.

oids.name: maximumTemperature
oids.description: An alert should be generated whenever the temperature of the first connected T sensor is above this value. Zero means disabled.

oids.name: displayOrientation
oids.description: 0 no display; display off; 1 vertical, display on top; 2 vertical, upside down; 3 horizontal, display at left; 4 horizontal, display at right

oids.name: localAlertReset
oids.description: Allow alerts to be reset locally on device by pushing one of the buttons. [replaces dipDuration]

oids.name: currentDropDetection
oids.description: Enables the current drop detection function. 0 = always off (default), 1 = input (s) only, 2 = output(s) only, 3 = both inputs and outputs.

oids.name: wirelessDisplayPower
oids.description: Controls the transit power of the wireless display transciever (if installed). Set to zero to completely disable the module.

oids.name: kWhTotalI
oids.description: Either the only phase in a single phase measurement; or one of the three phases in a multiphase measurement.

oids.name: kWhSubtotalI
oids.description: kWh subtotal register of the only phase in a single phase measurement; or one of three phases in a multiphase measurement. Reset to zero with [rsimks].

oids.name: powerFactorI
oids.description: The effective power factor in percent.

oids.name: actualCurrentI
oids.description: Actual apparent, RMS current.

oids.name: peakCurrentI
oids.description: Peak apparent, RMS current; highest value since last reset of the alerts.

oids.name: actualVoltageI
oids.description: The actual voltage.

oids.name: minVoltageI
oids.description: RMS voltage dip; lowest value since reset of alerts.

oids.name: powerVAI
oids.description: Power value calculated, not in data model of device.

oids.name: powerWattI
oids.description: Power value calculated by the gateway, not in data model of device.

oids.name: maxInletAmps
oids.description: Maximum current per input phase in A; should last at least [stpkdr] MilliSeconds before triggering an alert.

oids.name: inputCTratio
oids.description: The multiplier to use in case of use of /5 current transformers. Defaults to 1.

oids.name: inputName
oids.description: User configurable naming of inputs or phases. Useful if channels are used to measure branches..

oids.name: outletName
oids.description: User configurable naming of individual outlets. Useful to distinguish outlets based on customer or device name.

oids.name: kWhTotalO
oids.description: Total kWh of selected output.

oids.name: kWhSubtotalO
oids.description: kWh subtotal register of selected output. Reset to zero with [rsomks].

oids.name: powerFactorO
oids.description: Power factor of output.

oids.name: actualCurrentO
oids.description: Actual apparent, RMS current.

oids.name: peakCurrentO
oids.description: Peak apparent, RMS current; highest value since last reset of alerts.

oids.name: actualVoltageO
oids.description: Actual voltage on output.

oids.name: maxOutletAmps
oids.description: Maximum current per outlet in A; should last at least [stpkdr] MilliSeconds before triggering an alert.

oids.name: outputCTratio
oids.description: The multiplier to use in case of use of /5 current transformers. Defaults to 1.

oids.name: currentState
oids.description: The actual state of the outlet relays. The hardware will contain max 48 outlets. Writing is only effective after setting [swounl].

oids.name: scheduled
oids.description: A one indicates pending activity; the switch delay has not yet expired.

oids.name: unlock
oids.description: Setting the value to one will release the safety for this outlet for a couple seconds; switching and rebooting are then temporarily enabled.

oids.name: individualOutletDelay
oids.description: Delay before an individual outlet switches on at power-up in Seconds.

oids.name: sensorType
oids.description: Type of connected sensor, either T, H or I for respectively Temperature (C), Humidity (%) or dry switch contact

oids.name: sensorValue
oids.description: Value of connected sensor

oids.name: sensorName
oids.description: User definable name for sensors.

oids.name: sdbMgmtStsDevices
oids.description: The number of devices on the databus.

oids.name: sdbMgmtStsAddressableDevices
oids.description: The number of devices on the databus addressable by snmp.

oids.name: sdbMgmtStsNewDevices
oids.description: The number of new devices on the databus.

oids.name: sdbMgmtStsDuplicateDevices
oids.description: The number of duplicate devices on the databus.

oids.name: sdbMgmtStsRingState
oids.description: If the device is in a bridge-like mode, this will indicate the actual state of the databus.

oids.name: sdbMgmtStsRingBreachIndex
oids.description: Indicates the breach index if the current state of the data bus is open. If the data bus is closed this has no meaning.

oids.name: sdbMgmtCtrlScan
oids.description: Perform a bus scan. To verify if scanning is completed the value of this object can be read. During the bus scan the value remains 1. When the bus scan completed the value will be 0.

oids.name: sdbMgmtCtrlRenumberAllFromN
oids.description: Renumber all devices on the databus. If set to 0 all units will be set to 0. If set to another value, all units will be numbered in sequence starting from the value set.

oids.name: sdbMgmtCtrlRenumberZeros
oids.description: Renumber all devices on the databus having address 0. Renumbering will be done in sequence. The sequence starts with the highest address found on the databus.

oids.name: sdbMgmtCtrlDevUnitAddress
oids.description: User defined address. This will be used for addressing the device on the databus.

oids.name: sdbMgmtCtrlDevHardwareAddress
oids.description: Hardware serial number. This cannot be changed. It can be used as backup unit address. format as 3 unsigned ints separated by dashes: int - int - int

oids.name: sdbMgmtCtrlDevIsNew
oids.description: Indication if the device is new on the databus.

oids.name: sdbMgmtCtrlDevIsDuplicate
oids.description: Indication if the device is conflicting with another device on the databus.

oids.name: sdbDevCfOutletsMetered
oids.description: Number of metered outlets. If outlet numbering is non-contiguous its the highest outlet number.

oids.name: sdbDevCfSensors

oids.name: sdbDevCfMaximumLoad
oids.description: Maximum rated load of device per phase

oids.name: sdbDevCfBranches

oids.description: Nuetral current measurement.

oids.name: sdbDevCfTotals
oids.description: The number of totals rows for the configuration.

oids.name: sdbDevSsTemperatureAlert
oids.description: An alert has been raised due to temperature exceeding treshhold. 0 = no alert 1 = internal temperature sensor 2 = external temperature sensor

oids.name: sdbDevSsInputCurrentAlert
oids.description: An alert has been raised due to current exceeding treshhold. The value indicates the exceeding phase. 0 = no alert.

oids.name: sdbDevSsOutletCurrentAlert
oids.description: An alert has been raised due to current exceeding treshhold. The value indicates the exceeding outlet. 0 = no alert.

oids.name: sdbDevSsInputVoltageAlert
oids.description: An alert has been raised due to a voltage dip. The value indicates the dipped phase. 0 = no alert.

oids.name: sdbDevSsOutletCurrentDropAlert
oids.description: An alert has been raised due to the current of a metered outlet suddenly dropping to near zero, possibly indicating a blown fuse. The value indicates the dropped outlet. 0 = no alert.

oids.name: sdbDevSsInputCurrentDropAlert
oids.description: An alert has been raised due to the current of a metered input suddenly dropping to near zero, possibly indicating a blown fuse. The value indicates the dropped phase. 0 = no alert.

oids.name: sdbDevSsSensorChangeAlert
oids.description: An alert has been raised due to a change in the number of sensors. The value indicates the previous amount of sensors.

oids.name: sdbDevSsOutletVoltageDropAlert
oids.description: An alert has been raised due to voltage drop on this outlet. The value indicates the first failed outlet.

oids.name: sdbDevSsBranchCurrentAlert
oids.description: An alert has been raised due to current exceeding treshhold. The value indicates the exceeding branch. 0 = no alert.

oids.name: sdbDevSsBranchVoltageAlert
oids.description: An alert has been raised due to a voltage dip. The value indicates the dipped branch. 0 = no alert.

oids.name: sdbDevSsNeutralCurrentAlert
oids.description: An alert has been raised due to current exceeding treshhold. 0 = no alert 1 = current alert

oids.name: sdbDevSsResidualCurrentAlert
oids.description: A residual current alert has been raised. 0 = no alert 1 = current exceeding treshhold alert 2 = sensor error

oids.name: sdbDevSsHardwareAlert
oids.description: 0 = no alarm >0 = or slave number for alert
